free_parameters.name: k_len
free_parameters.why: witness trigger has k.shape=2; fixed equal to q_len on both sides so only the v length crosses the shape-equality boundary

free_parameters.name: batch
free_parameters.why: batch dimension common to q, k and v; not in the witness, smallest positive value

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: head count common to q, k and v; not in the witness, smallest value that still gives 4-D tensors

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: smallest head size in streaming_forward's supported list; avoids padding and keeps the CPU run small

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU-compatible dtype; the witness specifies no dtype

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed for deterministic tensor contents

free_parameters.name: n_init
free_parameters.why: streaming_kwargs n_init; only read by streaming_forward after the target, kept small

free_parameters.name: n_local
free_parameters.why: streaming_kwargs n_local; only read by streaming_forward after the target, kept small

free_parameters.name: head_id
free_parameters.why: head index argument of the entry; the streaming branch returns before it is used

free_parameters.name: streaming
free_parameters.why: witness predicate self.config...get('streaming') is true in the trigger and contrast

free_parameters.name: dilated1
free_parameters.why: witness predicate self.config...get('dilated1') is false in trigger and contrast

free_parameters.name: dilated2
free_parameters.why: witness predicate self.config...get('dilated2') is false in trigger and contrast

free_parameters.name: dense
free_parameters.why: witness predicate self.config...get('dense') is false in trigger and contrast

hooks.name: import_time_cpu_shim
hooks.purpose: CPU stand-in for the module-level torch.arange(device='cuda') LAST_Q_MASK constant and stubs for GPU-only sibling imports (flash_attn/pycuda/minference.cuda) that are not on the path to the target; the target module streaming_kernel and the entry function are the real repository code
